key_insight: LaGO uses a pretrained LLM as a soft latent action prior to guide online reinforcement learning, improving policy optimization without relying on the LLM as a direct controller.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a practical way to inject language-model knowledge into RL agents for better planning and decision-making in both discrete and continuous control settings.
method: Pretrain or reuse an LLM to provide latent action guidance.
Integrate this guidance into online policy optimization with PPO.
Let the RL policy learn actions while the LLM shapes exploration and decision bias softly.
evidence_signal: Across CLEVR-Robot and Meta-World, LaGO outperformed Vanilla PPO, raising average success rate from 15.1% to 27.2% and from 2.7% to 15.2%, respectively.
watch_item: Performance depends on the strength of the pretrained LLM, so weaker models or mismatched priors may provide limited guidance and require careful tuning.
paper_title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
